topic: 非谓语动词综合进阶大闯关 (Non-Finite Verbs: To-do, Doing & Done)
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：把动词想象成超级英雄！在一句话里，只能有一个“正牌主角”（主句谓语动词）。如果还想加入其他动词，它们就必须戴上“面具”变身为非谓语动词（to do, doing, done），去扮演名词、形容词或副词的角色。
2. 【公式与口诀】：结构公式：主语 + 谓语动词 + 非谓语动词 (to do / doing / done)。口诀：“一句不容二谓语，非谓变身来打工；to do 目的未发生，doing 主动进行中，done 字一出被动成！”
3. 【避坑指南】：① 介词后面要接动名词（如 good at swimming，切忌用原形）；② 混淆 stop to do（停下来去做另一件事）与 stop doing（停止正在做的事）；③ 中学压轴题中分词作状语时，容易忽略逻辑主语必须与主句主语保持一致（防止出现“悬垂分词”）。
4. 【经典例句】：
① She decided to study hard for the upcoming English exam.（她决定为了即将到来的英语考试努力学习。—— to do 表将来与目的）
② My brother enjoys listening to music after doing his homework.（我弟弟喜欢在做完作业后听音乐。—— doing 介词后及固定搭配）
③ Encouraged by his teacher, Tim passed the tough challenge.（受到老师的鼓励，蒂姆通过了艰难的挑战。—— done 表被动与完成）

questions.question: My sister enjoys ________ storybooks before going to bed every night.
questions.explanation: 【考点：固定搭配】enjoy 后面接动词时，必须使用动名词形式 enjoy doing sth.，意为“喜欢做某事”。

questions.question: The weather is very cold outside. Remember ________ your heavy coat when you leave.
questions.explanation: 【考点：remember的用法】记住“将要做某事”（动作尚未发生）用 remember to do sth.；如表示“记得做过某事”则用 doing。

questions.question: He was so tired that he stopped ________ (have) a short break under the tree.
questions.explanation: 【考点：stop的用法】stop to do sth. 表示“停下手中的事情，去开展另一件事（休息）”。

questions.question: Thank you for ________ me with my math homework yesterday.
questions.explanation: 【考点：介词后接doing】for 是介词，介词后面接动词时要用 V-ing 形式（动名词）。

questions.question: 【改错题】Please line up and avoid to make noise in the school library.
questions.answer: 将 to make 改为 making
questions.explanation: 【考点：avoid的用法】avoid 属于“只能接动名词”的动词词组（avoid doing sth.），意为“避免做某事”。

questions.question: Our English teacher decided ________ a spelling contest next Friday.
questions.explanation: 【考点：decide的用法】decide 后面固定接动词不定式（decide to do sth.），表示“决定做某事”。

questions.question: My little brother is interested in ________ (play) chess with my father.
questions.explanation: 【考点：be interested in结构】in 是介词，后面需使用动词的 -ing 形式 playing。

questions.question:
【句型转换】It is very important to brush your teeth every morning. (改为同义句)
________ your teeth every morning is very important.
questions.explanation: 【考点：动名词作主语】不定式作形式主语时，可改写为动名词（Brushing your teeth...）在句首作主语。

questions.question: The coffee is too hot for the little boy ________ right now.
questions.explanation: 【考点：too...to...句型】too + 形容词/副词 + for sb. + to do sth. 表示“太……以至于某人不能做某事”。

questions.question: The police officer asked the driver ________ (show) his driving license.
questions.explanation: 【考点：ask sb. to do】ask 属于要求类动词，常用结构为 ask somebody to do something（要求某人做某事）。

questions.question: 【改错题】The children spent two hours to clean the playground yesterday.
questions.answer: 将 to clean 改为 cleaning
questions.explanation: 【考点：spend句型】spend time (in) doing sth. 表示“花费时间做某事”，介词 in 可省略，动词须用 V-ing。

questions.question: Would you like ________ to the amusement park with us this Saturday?
questions.explanation: 【考点：would like的用法】would like 后面要接动词不定式（would like to do sth.），意为“想要做某事”。

questions.question:
【句型转换】Why don't we go camping near the lake this afternoon? (改为同义句)
How about ________ camping near the lake this afternoon?
questions.explanation: 【考点：建议句型转换】How about / What about 后面须接动名词 V-ing。

questions.question: Don't forget ________ (turn) off the lights before you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: 【考点：forget的用法】forget to do sth. 表示“不要忘记去实施尚未发生的动作”。

questions.question: I saw Tom ________ basketball on the playground when I walked past.
questions.explanation: 【考点：感官动词+doing】see sb. doing sth. 表示“看见某人正在做某事”（强调动作正在发生进行）。

questions.question: ________ the loud knock at the front door, the dog started barking fiercely.
questions.explanation: 【考点：现在分词作时间状语】逻辑主语 the dog 与 hear 之间是主动关系，用现在分词 Hearing 表示“一听到……”。

questions.question: ________ (finish) all the required documents, the manager signed his name on the contract.
questions.explanation: 【考点：现在分词的完成式】finish 动作发生在主句谓语 signed 之前，且主语 manager 是主动发出者，故填 Having finished。

questions.question: 【改错题】Comparing with last year's sales figures, our company has made significant progress.
questions.explanation: 【考点：过去分词作状语】主语 our company 与 compare 之间是被动关系（“与……相比”），应使用过去分词 Compared with。

questions.question:
【句型转换】Because he was deeply moved by the film, the boy could not stop crying. (改为分词短语作状语)
________ by the film, the boy could not stop crying.
questions.explanation: 【考点：过去分词作原因状语】省略从句主语和连词，动词 move 与主语 the boy 呈被动关系，保留过去分词短语 Deeply moved。

questions.question: With all the preparations ________, the annual science festival will begin on time.
questions.explanation: 【考点：With复合结构】“with + 宾语 + 宾补”，preparations（准备工作）与 complete 之间是被动且已完成关系，故用过去分词 completed。

questions.question: The doctor strongly advised him to give up ________ (smoke) to improve his health.
questions.explanation: 【考点：短语动词+doing】give up 属于“动词+介词”短语，介词 up 后接动名词 smoking。

questions.question: All the students are looking forward to ________ the famous scientist at the auditorium.
questions.explanation: 【考点：look forward to中to为介词】look forward to 中的 to 是介词而非不定式符号，后面必须接 V-ing（meeting）。

questions.question: 【改错题】Seeing from the top of the tower, the city looks like a huge chessboard.
questions.explanation: 【考点：分词逻辑主语一致性】主语是 the city，城市是被看（be seen），故分词必须用过去分词 Seen，避免悬垂分词错误。

questions.question:
【句型转换】Though he was tired, he kept on working to meet the deadline. (改为形容词/分词作状语)
________, he kept on working to meet the deadline.
questions.explanation: 【考点：分词/形容词作让步状语】省去状语从句主语和 be 动词，直接保留形容词/过去分词 Tired 作状语。

questions.question: The problem is so complex that it leaves us no choice but ________ for professional help.
questions.explanation: 【考点：have no choice but to do】have no choice but to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“别无选择只能做某事”。

questions.question: I deeply regret ________ (not listen) to my parent's advice when choosing my major.
questions.explanation: 【考点：regret+doing否定式】regret (not) doing / having done sth. 表示“后悔（没有）做过某事”。

questions.question: The boy ________ under the banyan tree with a book in his hand is our class monitor.
questions.explanation: 【考点：现在分词作后置定语】The boy 与 sit 为主动且正在进行的动作，作后置定语修饰 the boy，相当于 who is sitting。

questions.question: 【改错题】To tell you the truth, there is nothing for us to be worried about.
questions.answer: 将 to be worried about 改为 to worry about
questions.explanation: 【考点：不定式作后置定语的主被动】there is nothing to worry about 中，不定式在逻辑上修饰 nothing，约定俗成用主动形式表达被动含义。

questions.question:
【句型转换】After she had completed the project, she was granted a two-week holiday. (用现在分词完成式改写)
________ the project, she was granted a two-week holiday.
questions.explanation: 【考点：分词完成式作时间状语】Having completed 明确表达了动作发生的主从先后顺序。

questions.question: Weather ________ (permit), the outdoor graduation ceremony will be held on the central lawn tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 【考点：独立主格结构】Weather 是 permitting 的逻辑主语，与主句主语不一致且属于主动关系，构成 Weather permitting 独立主格作条件状语。
